purpose: Prevent extraction by treating contributor time, expertise, risk, and review labor as valuable even when no public record results.
principles: Compensation is for time and expertise, not for sensational content.
Payment must not be contingent on public release.
A contributor who withdraws should not be punished by loss of already-earned compensation.
Practitioner craft, family memory, deathcare/bodywork knowledge, and cultural review are expertise.
Credit choices must be separate from payment choices.

credit_modes.use: highest privacy; may reduce context too much for some records
e.g., hospice nurse, adult child, funeral director; default public mode if safe
when context matters and identifiability remains low
when contributor wants continuity without legal name
only with explicit approval and third-party risk review
only when authorized; never to imply whole-community endorsement unless given

payment_policy_todo: set fair baseline rates before recruitment
include prep time, interview time, transcript review time, and advisory review time
budget for accessibility, translation, childcare, transport, and support needs where relevant

avoid market logic that values rare trauma over ordinary craft
